products.description: 45 m² Dublin-manufactured light-gauge steel-frame modular unit described for self-contained apartment, multi-room workspace and two-bedroom uses. Published dimensions: 9.0 m × 5.0 m or 7.5 m × 6.0 m. Supplier states kitchen and bathroom are included, excluding appliances.
